summary.text: Cindy Neighbor is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 18 since January 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is the ranking minority member of the Insurance Committee, and Ballotpedia lists her as a former member of the Shawnee Mission School District board and the Kansas State Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Cindy Neighbor attended Johnson County Community College and Kansas City Kansas Community College.
According to Ballotpedia, her work experience includes serving as a medical administrator and as a public relations and marketing director.

She served as president of a parent teacher association, served on the founding committee of the Ronald McDonald House at the University of Kansas Medical Center, and was a member of the Board of Indigent Defense Services, the Kansas State Board of Education and the Teacher Credentialing Board.

Ballotpedia lists Neighbor as having previously held the District 18 House seat from 2003 to 2004 and from 2007 to 2011, and as having served on the Shawnee Mission School District board from 2005 to 2017.
She assumed office in the House again on January 9, 2017.

For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Child Welfare and Foster Care, Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, Insurance (ranking minority member), and Pensions, Investments and Benefits committees.
